summary: LUMI AI Writing Assistant - All features verified. Backend APIs (refine, smart-reply, translate, voice-to-text) and Frontend UI (toolbar buttons, dropdowns, integrations) fully functional.
critical_code_review_comments: AI Writing Toolbar code is clean and well-structured
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Button disabled states correctly tied to messageText.trim() and messages.length
Real LLM integration via emergentintegrations - no mocked APIs
context_for_next_testing_agent: LUMI AI Writing Assistant fully tested. All 4 features working: Refine (4 tones), Smart Reply (context-based suggestions), Translate (10 languages), Voice-to-Text (endpoint ready, UI state verified).

tested_features.details: All 4 instruction types working: professional, friendly, assertive, concise. Example: 'hey can u help me with this thing asap?' -> 'Could you please assist me with this matter at your earliest convenience?'
Generates 3 contextual reply suggestions based on conversation history and channel name
All 10 languages working (es, fr, de, ja, zh, ko, pt, ar, hi, ru). Returns translated_text, target_language, target_name
Endpoint exists, validates file format (mp3, mp4, wav, webm, etc.), returns 422 for missing file
Toolbar with data-testid='ai-writing-toolbar' appears when channel is active, positioned above message input
Shows dropdown with 4 options (Professional, Friendly, Assertive, Concise) with emoji icons. Button disabled when input empty.
Clicking tone option sends text to /api/lumi/ai/refine and updates message input with refined text
Shows scrollable dropdown with 10 languages. Button disabled when input empty.
Clicking language sends text to /api/lumi/ai/translate and updates message input. Tested: 'Hello, how are you today?' -> 'Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?'
Shows SMART REPLIES panel with 3 contextual suggestions. Clicking suggestion fills message input. Button disabled when no messages in channel.
Button present with toggle state (Voice/Stop). Recording state cannot be tested in headless browser but UI is interactive.
